items.title: Hungary's president agrees to stand down after parliament backs removal
items.description: Tamás Sulyok, seen as an Orbán loyalist, had until Saturday night to agree to end his term.

items.title: Hungary's president signs amendment ending his own term
items.description: An ally of former PM Viktor Orban has signed a constitutional amendment ending his own term as head of state. Tamas Sulyok criticized the law, while lawmakers insist he has impeded national progress by staying in office.
